name: privilege-owasp-lab
description: Privilege OWASP Lab: watch an identity admin automate PingOne with Ping CLI. 14 allow-listed, read-only pingcli commands streamed to the browser, with an easy-read table view. Mock plays canned output offline; Real runs the pinned pingcli binary against your own environment. Standalone version of the AI-DEMO2 /pingcli page.

scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
